candidates.snippet: 1831: Voyage of the Beagle - Embarked on the HMS Beagle for a five-year scientific expedition around the world, collecting specimens and making observations. 1859: Publication of 'On the Origin of Species' - Published his seminal work, 'On the Origin of Species,' introducing the theory of evolution by natural selection. 1871: Publication of 'The Descent of Man' - Published 'The Descent of Man, and Selection in Relation to Sex,' applying his theory to human evolution. 1882: Death of Charles Darwin - Died at Down House, Kent, England, leaving a profound legacy in science and natural history.
